Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin

 begin
 select substr(mc.code_desc,1,32) into :ctrl_blk_1.s_type_desc
 from equipment e, equip_master_codes mc
 where e.equip_type=:s_type
 and mc.code_type = 'EQUIP'
 and mc.code = :ctrl_blk_1.s_type
 and e.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 exception

 show_error ('1306');
 check_package_failure;
 when too_many_rows then
 null;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
end;

Trigger.Name: PRE-BLOCK
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 :d_equip_type := :equipment.equip_type;
 :d_equip_id := :equipment.equip_id;
 :d_equip_ref := :equipment.equip_reference;
 :d_start_date := :equipment.first_production_date;
 begin
 select substr(mc.code_desc,1,22) into :d_equip_desc
 from equip_master_codes mc
 where code_type = 'EQUIP'
 and code = :d_equip_type;
 exception when others then null;
 end;
-- MONTH TO DATE STUFF
 select decode(least(:d_start_date, trunc(sysdate, 'MM')),
 :d_start_date, to_number(to_char(sysdate,'DD')),
 to_number(to_char(sysdate,'DD'))-
 to_number(to_char(:d_start_date,'DD')))
 into :mtd_days
 from dual;
 begin
 select count(ee.event_reference),
 sum (ee.downtime_end - ee.downtime_start) * 24
 into :mtd_events, :mtd_totals
 from equipment_event ee
 where ee.equip_reference = :downtime_stats.d_equip_ref
 and ee.downtime_code is not null
 and ee.downtime_start is not null
 and ee.downtime_end is not null
 and ee.downtime_start between greatest (trunc(sysdate,'MM'),
 :downtime_stats.d_start_date) and trunc(sysdate+1);
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 :mtd_totals := 0;
 :mtd_events := 0;
 end;
 if (:mtd_events = 0) then
 :mtd_totals := 0;
 end if;
 :mtd_percent := (((:mtd_days*24)-:mtd_totals)/(:mtd_days*24))*100;
-- NOW FOR MONTHLY STATS
 if (:d_start_date > trunc(sysdate, 'MM')-1) then
 :mon_days := 0;
 :mon_events := 0;
 :mon_totals := 0;
 :mon_percent := 0;
 else
 select decode(
 least(:d_start_date, trunc(trunc(sysdate,'MM')-1,'MM')),
 :d_start_date,
 to_number(to_char(trunc(sysdate, 'MM')-1, 'DD')),
 to_number(to_char(trunc(sysdate, 'MM')-1, 'DD'))-
 to_number(to_char(:d_start_date,'DD')))
 into :mon_days
 from dual;
 begin
 select count(ee.event_reference),
 sum (ee.downtime_end - ee.downtime_start) * 24
 into :mon_events, :mon_totals
 from equipment_event ee
 where ee.equip_reference = :downtime_stats.d_equip_ref
 and ee.downtime_code is not null
 and ee.downtime_start is not null
 and ee.downtime_end is not null
 and ee.downtime_start between
 greatest(trunc(trunc(sysdate, 'MM')-1, 'MM'),
 :d_start_date) and trunc(sysdate, 'MM');
 exception when no_data_found then
 :mon_totals := 0;
 :mon_events := 0;
 end;
 if (:mon_events = 0) then
 :mon_totals := 0;
 end if;
 :mon_percent := (((:mon_days*24)-:mon_totals)/(:mon_days*24))*100;
 end if;
--- YEAR TO DATE STATISTICS
 select decode(least(:d_start_date, trunc(sysdate, 'YY')),
 :d_start_date, to_number(to_char(sysdate,'DDD')),
 to_number(to_char(sysdate,'DDD'))-
 to_number(to_char(:d_start_date,'DDD')))
 into :ytd_days
 from dual;
 begin
 select count(ee.event_reference),
 sum (ee.downtime_end - ee.downtime_start) * 24
 into :ytd_events, :ytd_totals
 from equipment_event ee
 where ee.equip_reference = :downtime_stats.d_equip_ref
 and ee.downtime_code is not null
 and ee.downtime_start is not null
 and ee.downtime_end is not null
 and ee.downtime_start between greatest (trunc(sysdate,'YY'),
 :downtime_stats.d_start_date) and trunc(sysdate+1);
 exception when no_data_found then
 :ytd_totals := 0;
 :ytd_events := 0;
 end;
 if (:ytd_events = 0) then
 :ytd_totals := 0;
 end if;
 :ytd_percent := (((:ytd_days*24)-:ytd_totals)/(:ytd_days*24))*100;
--- PAST YEAR DATA
 if (:d_start_date > trunc(sysdate, 'YY')-1) then
 :yr_days := 0;
 :yr_events := 0;
 :yr_totals := 0;
 :yr_percent := 0;
 else
 select decode(least
 (:d_start_date, trunc(trunc(sysdate,'YY')-1,'YY')),
 :d_start_date,to_number(to_char(trunc(sysdate,'YY')-1,'DDD')),
 to_number(to_char(trunc(sysdate, 'YY')-1, 'DDD'))-
 to_number(to_char(:d_start_date,'DDD')))
 into :yr_days
 from dual;
 begin
 select count(ee.event_reference),
 sum (ee.downtime_end - ee.downtime_start) * 24
 into :yr_events, :yr_totals
 from equipment_event ee
 where ee.equip_reference = :downtime_stats.d_equip_ref
 and ee.downtime_code is not null
 and ee.downtime_start is not null
 and ee.downtime_end is not null
 and ee.downtime_start between
 greatest(trunc(trunc(sysdate, 'YY')-1, 'YY'),
 :d_start_date) and trunc(sysdate, 'YY');
 exception when no_data_found then
 :yr_totals := 0;
 :yr_events := 0;
 end;
 if (:yr_events = 0) then
 :yr_totals := 0;
 end if;
 :yr_percent := (((:yr_days*24)-:yr_totals)/(:yr_days*24))*100;
 end if;
end;

RecordGroup.Name: CTRL_BLK_1_S_ID_LOV1
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select e.equip_id, e.equip_reference, substr(decode(least(nvl(e.first_production_date, trunc(sysdate)+1), trunc(sysdate)+1), trunc(sysdate)+1, 'Not yet in service.', 'Service from: '||to_char(e.first_production_date, 'MM-DD-YY')||' to: '||nvl(to_char(e.last_production_date, 'MM-DD-YY'), 'Present')),1,38) from equipment e where e.equip_type=:s_type and e.chapter_id = :ctrl_blk_1.s_chapter_id order by decode(least(nvl(e.first_production_date, trunc(sysdate)+1), trunc(sysdate)+1), trunc(sysdate)+1, '2', decode(least(nvl(e.last_production_date, trunc(sysdate)), trunc(sysdate)), trunc(sysdate), '1', '3')), e.equip_id

RecordGroup.Name: CTRL_BLK_1_S_REF_LOV
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select e.equip_reference, substr(decode(least(nvl(e.first_production_date, trunc(sysdate)+1), trunc(sysdate)+1), trunc(sysdate)+1, 'Not yet in service.', 'Service from: '||to_char(e.first_production_date, 'MM-DD-YY')||' to: '||nvl(to_char(e.last_production_date, 'MM-DD-YY'), 'Present')),1,38) from equipment e where e.equip_type=:ctrl_blk_1.s_type and e.equip_id = :ctrl_blk_1.s_id and e.chapter_id = :ctrl_blk_1.s_chapter_id

RecordGroup.Name: CTRL_BLK_1_STATUS_LOV
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select mc.code, substr(mc.code_desc,1,32) from equip_master_codes mc where mc.code_type = 'STATS' and sysdate between mc.eff_date and nvl(mc.term_date, sysdate+1)
